dedupe_keys.name: lf energy seapath real time high availability hypervisor for virtualised substation protection and control

description: SEAPATH is an open-source reference platform for running virtualised protection, automation and control (vPAC) applications in IEC 61850 digital substations. It is developed as an LF Energy project by grid operators, vendors and integrators under the Digital Substation special interest group. Coverage: generic, for any utility substation. The platform combines a real-time Linux hypervisor, a high-availability cluster with Ceph shared storage and cyber security hardening, built either as Yocto images or as a Debian installer image, and configured with Ansible playbooks (network and cluster set-up) onto standard servers. Format and access: source code, build recipes and documentation in the seapath GitHub organisation; free. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: SEAPATH is an infrastructure layer, not a protection application; users must bring vPAC software and qualified hardware, and real-time performance depends on careful tuning. Simulation uses: building hardware-in-the-loop and digital twin testbeds of virtualised substations to study resilience and cascading failure of control functions under faults or cyber attack. Related records: LF Energy CoMPAS (platform-lf-energy-compas-iec61850) produces the IEC 61850 configurations that such substations run, and SANDI-2024 substation traffic (data-sandi-2024-substation-intrusion-detection) is data from a substation testbed.
